name: IndiaInsurances MCP
summary: Free, keyless MCP and REST API that quotes Indian insurance policy clauses from the insurers' own wordings, with comparisons and claim paths.
description: Remote Streamable HTTP MCP at https://indiainsurances.com/mcp needs no account, key or OAuth. 21 tools include search_policies, find_policies, get_policy, search_policy_text, get_policy_clause, compare_policies, get_insurer, search_insurance_law, complaint_path, draft_complaint, forms, registered-agent lookup, request_help and report_correction. Site reports tens of thousands of IRDAI-listed products and documents; facts carry clause and page citations. Rate limit 120 requests a minute per IP. Independent, no commission; not an insurer or intermediary. Companion REST under /api/v1/.

agent_access.notes: No auth for lookups. See /auth.md and /pricing.md.
